definitions.explanation: Doing something with complete focus and dedication, without distraction.

examples.japanese: ひたすら{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けた。
ひたすら{謝|あやま}るしかなかった。
examples.english: All I could do was keep apologizing.

examples.japanese: ひたすら{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けた。

notes:
ひたすら emphasizes doing something with complete dedication and focus, often implying persistence over time.

USAGE:
Typically modifies verbs describing continuous actions. Conveys that one does nothing but that action.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ひたすら〜{続|つづ}ける: to keep doing ~ single-mindedly
- ひたすら{待|ま}つ: to just wait and wait
- ひたすら{謝|あやま}る: to keep apologizing
- ひたすら{努力|どりょく}する: to work hard single-mindedly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ただ〜だけ: just, only (neutral)
- {一心|いっしん}に: wholeheartedly
- {黙々|もくもく}と: silently and steadily
